issues.display_title: Issue #1680: Migrate addDataGPS to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Wrap to strict Domain-Based ADR pattern: DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope.

Endpoint: POST /tours/add-gps
Controller: Tours\ToursController@addDataGPS
Category: B — already delegates to legacy Action class, mechanical conformance pass.

Work:

  • Create DTO
  • Create Repository
  • Create ExceptionMapper
  • Wrap response in standard envelope
  • Update route to new controller
  • Add/update tests

Dev Note — After Implementation

Done in PR #1687, plus follow-up commit d09bd07.

  • Extracted to AddDataGPSController + AddDataGPSAction + AddDataGPSDto; route moved from the no-auth group into the auth group, legacy Actions/AddDataGPS.php and the ToursController method removed.
  • ToursRepository: added getBluelineModerationInfo, getPanoramaIdsForGPS, setModerationGpsFlag.
  • New domain exceptions: SubscriptionNotAllowedException (TOURS.SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_ALLOWED → 401) and BlulineOnlyException (TOURS.BLUELINE_ONLY → 409).
  • Auth move is not a breaking change: the legacy action already validated the Authorization header itself and rejected missing/expired tokens.
  • Fixed bug found while migrating: getPanoramaIdsForGPS first read the legacy helper name literally and filtered 5_pano_id IS NULL OR ''. PublishClass::getPanosInfoNoPanoId() never filtered on 5_pano_id — its real predicate is linked_moderation_id = 0 OR NULL. The wrong predicate skipped panoramas already published to Google (gps flag never set while the endpoint still returned 200) and queued panoramas linked in from another moderation. Legacy predicate restored verbatim, including the '0' string bind.
  • Also fixed: the RabbitMQ publish loop is wrapped in try/finally, so an AMQP failure mid-batch cannot leak the connection.
  • 6 unit tests, passing — subscription gate, ownership check, blueline tour-type check, LIVE happy path (payload shape, one job per panorama, monotonic timestamp), no-panoramas (gps flag must not be set), non-LIVE (gps flag set, nothing queued).
  • Docs: docs/v2/tours/misc/add-gps.md; registered as migrated API #198 in ADR_MIGRATED_APIS.md.

issues.display_title: Issue #1681: Migrate addExtraPlaceId to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Wrap to strict Domain-Based ADR pattern: DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope.

Endpoint: POST /tours/placeid/{mid}
Controller: Tours\ToursController@addExtraPlaceId
Category: B — already delegates to legacy Action class, mechanical conformance pass.

Work:

  • Create DTO
  • Create Repository
  • Create ExceptionMapper
  • Wrap response in standard envelope
  • Update route to new controller
  • Add/update tests

Dev Note — After Implementation

Done in PR #1689.

  • Extracted to AddExtraPlaceIdController + AddExtraPlaceIdAction + AddExtraPlaceIdDto; route moved from the no-auth group into the auth group, legacy Actions/AddExtraPlaceIds.php and the ToursController method removed.
  • ToursRepository: added updateExtraPlaceIds. Ownership check and main-place-ID lookup share a single getModerationInfoByOwner call instead of two round trips.
  • New domain exception MaxExtraPlaceIdsException (TOURS.MAX_EXTRA_PLACE_IDS → 409); added the missing tours.max_place_id key to the id locale.
  • Behaviour fix 1 — the moderation's own place ID is now actually stripped. Legacy guarded with $placeId != trim($val), where $placeId came from ConstellationClass::getPlaceId(), which returns (array) $row. In PHP 8 an array compared against a string is never equal, so the guard never fired in production. Moderations whose extra_place_ids still contain their own main place ID lose that entry on the next save.
  • Behaviour fix 2 — place IDs are trimmed before the ChIJ prefix check. Legacy ran strpos($v, 'ChIJ') === 0 on the raw value, so " ChIJx" was silently dropped (HTTP 200, entry just missing) while "ChIJx " was accepted and trimmed later — an accident of call ordering, not a validation rule. Dedupe now treats 'ChIJa', 'ChIJa ' and ' ChIJa' as one ID, and the 50-entry cap is counted on the normalised set.
  • Auth move is not a breaking change: the legacy action validated the token itself. Authenticate merges user_id from the token, so the controller's user_id is token-derived and not client-spoofable.
  • 6 unit tests, passing — not-owner throws, >50 IDs throws, empty array clears the column, stored payload after filter/dedupe/trim/strip/serialize, whitespace variants collapsing to one ID, main-place-ID-only input clearing the column. Plus a route test asserting the path resolves to AddExtraPlaceIdController@handle behind auth.
  • Docs: docs/v2/tours/misc/add-extra-placeid.md; registered as migrated API #199 in ADR_MIGRATED_APIS.md.

issues.display_title: Issue #1682: Migrate getDetailTourMerge to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Wrap to strict Domain-Based ADR pattern: DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope.

Endpoint: GET /v1/tours/detail
Controller: Tours\ToursController@getDetailTourMerge
Category: B — already delegates to legacy Action class, mechanical conformance pass.

Work:

  • Create DTO
  • Create Repository
  • Create ExceptionMapper
  • Wrap response in standard envelope
  • Update route to new controller
  • Add/update tests

Note from Dev — 2026-07-28

PR #1690. Route now points at Tours\GetDetailTourMergeController@handle; the legacy 751-line action and the getDetailTourMerge method on ToursController are deleted.

Layers: GetDetailTourMergeController → GetDetailTourMergeAction → GetDetailTourMergeDto + ToursRepository (9 new methods). New exception VirtualTourNotFoundException (TOURS.VIRTUAL_TOUR_NOT_FOUND → 409, carries data.details.tour_key); ownership failure stays TOURS.NOT_TOUR_OWNER → 409.

Response contract unchanged. All 47 detail_tour keys verified against the deleted action by an automated key-set diff; the SQL moved into the repository is equivalent character-for-character, and both envelopes (encrypted and enc: false) keep their shape.

Intentional deviations:

  1. daysLeft on the adopt-existing-tour path — legacy subtracted a date string numerically, so expired came out at ~19,700 days. Now uses strtotime().
  2. NotTourOwnerException uses the shared messages.not_owner text, not the legacy sentence.

Fixed during review: getPreviewHostedTours hit a non-existent preview_hosted_tours table (503 on every request); getAddressByPlaceId() was called on HelperClass instead of ToursClass (500); moderation_id had flipped to int, the preview-expiry dates to null, and the not-found error had lost its details wrapper; side effects ran before the payload build.

Docs: registered as #200 in ADR_MIGRATED_APIS.md, ToursController now fully drained, new page docs/v2/tours/misc/get-detail-tour-merge.md.

Tests: tests/Actions/Tours/ tests/Routes/ → 367 passing, 566 assertions. The 4 remaining errors are AIBlurActionTest, pre-existing on main.
